> LumaTilt is a 24x72 LED Matrix Display that can be used to display graphics. The LED Matrix consists of 1728 0402 SMD LED's that are multiplexed to form the 24x72 matrix.

## Design

### 2026-10-31: First entry,

**9.48h**

First entry,

Started with creating the project in EasyEDA and finding all of the necessary components. After adding the components to the schematic googled the Esp32 C3 Mini 1 Datasheet to view the required components and PCB layout recommendations. After that created the LED matrix and wired up the row and column controllers. After the Schematic was done went on to the PCB layout and track routing. Laid out the LED matrix and wired all the LED's up. After that laid out the other components and made some of the necessary connections.

And that's it!

[Timelapse](https://lookout.hackclub.com/api/media/542de6c3-3507-4e9b-9240-45116167097c/video.mp4)

### 2026-11-01: Second entry,

**3.42h**

Second entry,

Previously i had connected all of the mosfets to the led rows but hadn't connected them to the shift registers so i started with that. After finishing that and doing some of the remaining connections that i had missed added the project name and some cool graphics, poured the top and bottom GND copper layers, added a switch to change the display modes and exported all of the needed files.

And that is it!

[Timelapse](https://lookout.hackclub.com/api/media/05fc8b1e-810f-4af0-9c6c-343837f8bede/video.mp4)
